title: Mushroom body output neurons
description: All MaleCNS v1.0 neurons annotated as mushroom body output neurons (class MBON), with the directed connections among them that have at least 3 synapses.

source.citation: Berg, S., Beckett, I. R., Costa, M., Schlegel, P., Januszewski, M., et al. (2025). Sexual dimorphism in the complete connectome of the Drosophila male central nervous system. bioRxiv. https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.10.09.680999

license.name: CC BY 4.0
license.attribution: Connectome data from MaleCNS male-cns:v1.0 by FlyEM (HHMI Janelia), the University of Cambridge, the MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology, and Google Research, licensed CC BY 4.0. Filtered to mushroom body output neurons and connections with at least 3 synapses.

rules: Selected every body whose annotation class is MBON.
Kept connections whose source and target are both selected bodies.
Removed self-connections before applying the synapse threshold.
Kept connections with at least 3 synapses; synapseCount is the upstream weight value, unchanged.
Rejected duplicate pairs, missing endpoints, and non-positive counts.
Recorded missing annotation values as null.
extraction.startNeuronRule: Within the largest strongly connected component, order neurons by out-degree (descending), total outgoing synapses (descending), and numeric ID (ascending); take the first neuron of each type until 8 are chosen.
